source: GitHub accessible repository inventory for owner thebrazenbeard

inventory_digests.algorithm: SHA-256 over lexicographically sorted repository names, UTF-8, one name per line with trailing newline

privacy_rule: Private repository names are intentionally not published by this public repository. Private repositories still participate in aggregate counts and digest commitments.
archived_rule: The two archived repositories are private; their names remain omitted from the public artifact. Archived repositories are included in total/private/all-name digest counts and excluded from active counts.
relationship_to_v1: PORTFOLIO_CENSUS_V1 remains historical evidence for the earlier public-observatory cut and its coupled validator/graph/intake artifacts. V2 records the live repository inventory without pretending those older exact-head observatory artifacts have already been regenerated.
